notes: All three round 0 fixes are in place: V1 (CMS removed and the bundling term explained on LinkedIn), V2 (F4's basis added to Instagram) and V3 (the 'You can put AI to work the same way' line cut). The five quotes behind the fact ids the draft uses (F2, F4, F5, F6, F12) all verified word-for-word. The hedges 'likely' and 'approximately' are kept on both platforms. No savings figure is worked out. Neither draft says DN or Rob handled the case. The death and the family are not used as a hook. Both platforms use 'you'. Fact density is 5 ids on LinkedIn and 4 on Instagram, within the limits. The timeframe is evergreen, so no date or recency claim was checked. On the bundling explanation ('Bundling rules say which services must be billed as one charge.'): verify_quotes shows the post never defines bundling, so this sentence is not in the ledger. I did not count it as an unsourced claim. It is the plain explanation that Mechanics ('No insider word without a plain explanation next to it') requires for an insider term in F4. It says nothing new about the case, its numbers or its people. It is an accurate plain description of how Medicare bundling works. The Writer disclosed it openly in changes_made. Counting it as a hard violation would conflict with the doctrine rule that required it.
